title: Loaded Sweet Potatoes with Chilli Beef
desc: Baked sweet potatoes split and loaded with a quick chilli beef and bean mince, cheese and spring onion.

portions.J: 1 large sweet potato (350 g), 180 g raw mince worth of chilli, 18 g cheese
portions.P: 1 medium sweet potato (250 g), 120 g raw mince worth of chilli, 12 g cheese

ingredients.name: Chilli spices (cumin, smoked paprika, chipotle or chilli)

steps.title: Bake the sweet potatoes
steps.text: Oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Prick the sweet potatoes all over and bake on a tray until completely soft. (Or microwave 8 to 10 minutes, then 10 minutes in the oven to crisp the skin.)

steps.title: Brown the mince
steps.text: Hot pan, brown the mince with the onion until any liquid cooks off.

steps.title: Chilli
steps.text: Add the garlic and spices for a minute, then the beans and tomatoes. Simmer until thick.

steps.title: Load and serve
steps.text: Split the sweet potatoes, fluff the insides with a fork, pile in the chilli, then cheese and spring onion.

notes: The chilli doubles easily and freezes, for an even faster version next time.
